objective: Connect bounded recent-failure records to independent native diagnosis while preserving current policy, process cleanup and distinct qualification gates.
decisions: Keep one bounded advisory journal per explicitly selected probe invocation; no implicit discovery, overwrite, product retention or process authority.
Capture each fault snapshot, confirm owned failed-child cleanup, then perform optional journal I/O; record original observation time/stop fact.
Classify failure details as operational and prevent reader invocation under current export or inspector/accessibility denial.
Use the shared codec on all three profiles and native private-file adapters only on the modern Windows/Linux profiles.
Preserve compiler and observer failures; retain Windows reparse and protected-policy deployment as unexecuted qualification.
